research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Whatfix is researching systems for providing digital guidance corresponding to software applications by capturing current user interfaces, detecting potential elements of interest, and creating steps for providing digital guidance to an underlying application. Work on updating interactive service to simulate operations of an application and real time relocation of overlay components in a digital adoption platform enables hyper-personalizing digital guidance content across web and mobile interfaces.
